content: Static configuration between ProvidedServiceInstance and ConsumedServiceInstance If the ProvidedServiceInstance contains a remoteUnicastAddress reference to an ApplicationEndpoint the SoAd will setup one single SocketConnection between the localUnicastAddress and the remoteUnicastAddress .
